只让 L0 主往复轴参与控制；L1 / L2 / R0 / R1 / R2、V0: Only L0 participates; ignores L1 / L2 / R0 / R1 / R2, V0 / V1 / V2 and A0 / A1 / A2.
保留 L0，姿态轴与 A0 / A1 / A2 锁定在中位，V0 / V1 /: Keeps L0; locks rotation and A0 / A1 / A2 at center, ignores V0 / V1 / V2. Useful when only stroke should move with a fixed pose.

当前斜率方式为“无”，因此这个速度限制暂时不会参与输出；切回时间或速度后会继续沿: Motion mode is None, so this limit is currently inactive. It applies again when Time or Speed is selected.

本地骨骼/PB 测量。四路解算参考坐标系内的位置；PB 把手仅在抓取时有效。这不: Local bone/PB measurement. Four channels solve position in the reference frame; the PB handle is valid only while grabbed. This is not remote SPS or GPU mesh position.

近接信号：Others 表示他人，Self 表示自身。含义取决于生成器的接收器位: Proximity signal: Others means other players, Self means yourself. Meaning depends on receiver placement and radius, not a universal coordinate system.

摩擦近接信号，通常用于振动；不是轴向深度。: Friction proximity signal, commonly used for vibration, not axial depth.
侧向接收器的原始近接值，不是角度（度）；受位移与方向共同影响。: Raw side-receiver proximity, not degrees; affected by both displacement and orientation.
